### You Don’t Drift Into Spiritual Health: What Luke 2:52 Teaches Us About Becoming More Like Jesus
Author: Dave Ferguson
Site: Bible Gateway
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/learn/biblical-living/discipleship/becoming-more-like-jesus/
Passage: Luke 2:52
Points:
- Spiritual maturity does not happen by accident, as the human heart naturally drifts without intentional effort.
- Luke 2:52 reveals that Jesus intentionally developed across four core areas: wisdom, stature, and favor with God and people.
- These dimensions form a practical daily dashboard covering mental, physical, spiritual, and relational health.
- Dedicating a few minutes each day to examine these four areas helps believers detect drift and make timely adjustments.

### Day 133: Luke 2:48–50
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-133-luke-2-4850.html
Passage: Luke 2:48-50
Points:
- Christ's inner pull toward His Father was essential and inevitable to His nature, drawing Him naturally to the temple.
- Believers are free to bring their honest questions to Jesus, even when understanding His answers takes time.
- Jesus' words show a life centered entirely on God rather than personal ambition or secondary pursuits.
- The highest aim of the Christian life is to be so devoted to God that others naturally expect to find us in Him.
